participating-org.narrative:
Training on Attitude, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (TAKSA) is a social enterprise providing services to support organization in the areas of public speaking, communication, soft skills, leadership, organizational management and project management.
After 20 years of experience in public speaking, communication and social development, we know and understand the reasons that many people fearto speak in public, why they have less effective communication and need more leadership management. TAKSA provides both quality public and in-house training programs to government entities, private enterprises, Non-Profit Association (NPA), International Non-government Organizations (INGOs) and UN development partners.
TAKSA applies Adult Learning Theory – Andragogy (ALT) to design the training programs. ALT principles are applied to the way the training and coaching are designed and delivered. ALT suggests that adults are independent learners, adults are self-directed, adults learn for now, adults learn from trainers and from others, adults fear failure, adults question the need to learn, adults learn by listening to others and also sharing their knowledge and adults have variedexperience.
